phylogeny.name: Sparse accessory genome (demo)
phylogeny.description: 50 synthetic strains in six lineages, each carrying 18 accessory-genome genes as <property> elements: an ordinal certainty 0..4 that the gene is present (0 definitely absent .. 4 definitely present), with a blank cell meaning NOT ASSESSED rather than absent. Turn on Heat Map under Display Data, then compare the two clustered orders under Order columns: the eight rare genes (six prophages and two hypotheticals, each in under 15% of the strains) sit in eight adjoining columns under "Clustered (co-occurrence)", which counts the strains they are jointly ABSENT from as agreement, and scatter to the capsule types they actually occur with under "Clustered (ignoring shared absence)". No real organism is represented.
